# SoundCloud

1 endpoint, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/soundcloud/track - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a public SoundCloud track by its link: title, the artist's handle and name, plays (`post.engagement.views`), likes, comments, reposts (`post.engagement.shares`), the genre (`post.ext.genre`), artwork, length in seconds and the publish time. The length is the full track's; when only the 30 second preview's length is known it is null rather than the preview's. Playlists (sets) are not tracks and answer 400. When the first source cannot answer, a further source serves the track.

**Use when** you have a track link and want its reach on SoundCloud.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - SoundCloud track link, https://soundcloud.com/<artist>/<track>. · e.g. `https://soundcloud.com/kehlanimusic/lights-on-feat-big-sean`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+13 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {display_name}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares, views}; `post.flags` {deleted}; `post.ext` {genre}. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/soundcloud/track" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://soundcloud.com/kehlanimusic/lights-on-feat-big-sean" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/soundcloud/artist` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
- `GET /v1/soundcloud/artist/tracks` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
